title: Étale/pro-étale comparison intertwines scalar direct-image mates
statement:
Let $f:X\to Y$ be a quasi-compact quasi-separated morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-finite-type-morphism, def-weil-quasi-separated-morphism], and let $a:A\to B$ be a homomorphism of discrete commutative rings. On the small étale and pro-étale sites use ordinary uncompleted derived categories of sheaves of modules over the constant ring sheaves [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf, def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Write $T_Z^{t}=B_Z\otimes^L_{A_Z}-$ for derived scalar extension on either site $t=\mathrm{et},\mathrm{proet}$ [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings], and $\nu_Z:Z_{\mathrm{proet}}\to Z_{\mathrm{et}}$ for the comparison morphism [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism]. Let $J\in D^+(X_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ and assume $T_X^{\mathrm{et}}J\in D^+(X_{\mathrm{et}},B)$.

For $R=A,B$ let $\beta^R_L:\nu_Y^*Rf^{\mathrm{et}}_{*,R}L\xrightarrow{\sim}Rf^{\mathrm{proet}}_{*,R}\nu_X^*L$ be the canonical comparison of [sk-thm-pe-direct-image-comparison]. Let $\delta_{Z,L}:T_Z^{\mathrm{proet}}\nu_Z^*L\xrightarrow{\sim}\nu_Z^*T_Z^{\mathrm{et}}L$ be the canonical tensor comparison [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback]. On each site define $\gamma^t_L:T_Y^tRf^t_{*,A}L\to Rf^t_{*,B}T_X^tL$ as the adjoint transpose of $T_X^t(\varepsilon^A_L)$ after the canonical pullback/tensor identification, with $\varepsilon^A$ the counit of $f_A^*\dashv Rf_{*,A}$ [def-kun-projection-formula-map, def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations, def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate]. Then the following is an equality of $B$-linear morphisms:
$$
Rf^{\mathrm{proet}}_{*,B}(\delta_{X,J})\circ\gamma^{\mathrm{proet}}_{\nu_X^*J}
=\beta^B_{T_X^{\mathrm{et}}J}\circ\nu_Y^*(\gamma^{\mathrm{et}}_J)\circ\delta_{Y,Rf^{\mathrm{et}}_{*,A}J}\circ T_Y^{\mathrm{proet}}((\beta^A_J)^{-1}).
$$
No invertibility of $\gamma^{\mathrm{et}}$ or $\gamma^{\mathrm{proet}}$ and no flatness of $B$ over $A$ is assumed.

proof.text: Use $C,l,p,T,c,d,\delta$ of [lem-sfb-etale-proetale-scalar-pullback-cube] and put $r_R=Rf_{\mathrm{et},*,R}$, $s_R=Rf_{\mathrm{proet},*,R}$, $P=r_AJ$. The cube identity holds at $M=P$, since that theorem applies to every unbounded $M$. In particular it imposes no boundedness on $T_Y^eP$.

source.place: Formal properties and Finite rings paragraphs: transport of the canonical scalar mate through the site comparison; counit-transpose calculation (Stacks Tag 07A7, remark-base-change)

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-etale-proetale-scalar-counit-transposes] with the identity of Step 1. Its $U$ and $V$ are the requested left and right sides before cancelling $T_Y^p(\beta^A_J)$, and it gives $U^\flat=V^\flat$. The beta maps here agree with those in the statement: [sk-thm-pe-direct-image-comparison] specifies precisely their counit-compatible mate normalization.

source.place: Formal properties and Finite rings paragraphs: transport of the canonical scalar mate through the site comparison; counit-transpose calculation (Stacks Tag 07A7, remark-base-change)

proof.text: The canonical adjunction $p_B\dashv s_B$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations] has an injective Hom bijection. Applying its inverse to the equality of counit transposes gives $U=V$ [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate]. This is an equality of $B$-linear morphisms.

source.place: Formal properties and Finite rings paragraphs: transport of the canonical scalar mate through the site comparison; counit-transpose calculation (Stacks Tag 07A7, remark-base-change)

proof.text: The map $\beta^A_J$ is invertible by [sk-thm-pe-direct-image-comparison], since $f$ is qcqs and $J\in D^+$. Precompose $U=V$ with $T_Y^p((\beta^A_J)^{-1})$; functoriality cancels the adjacent inverse pair and gives exactly the displayed assertion. The same comparison theorem applies over $B$ at $T_X^eJ\in D^+$ as assumed. Neither scalar mate is inverted.
